'''Novinyet Biochemical Corporation''' was a biochemical company that was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aphiram Clay]] vigorously defended the company despite evidence of its shady dealings, and investigation into Clay uncovered bribes by Novinyet.
